person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Josie H. Carter in Box 110 without rank or a private identifier. The official Army file has no exact-name row, and official, CIA, Library of Congress, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches produced no defensible identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 110 for full name, birth year, identifiers, personnel status, employer, occupation, and pre-OSS chronology. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified OSS index and the official Army merged file agree on Lewis A. Carter's exact private identifier and name. The identifier remains withheld.
